goals.title: Keep recs flowing from producers to the auto-queue
goals.description: recs_dispatched per tick; sustained 0 while producer accumulators hold open recs = pipeline stall. Verified emitted key.

goals.title: Walk every producer with open recs
goals.description: producers_dispatched should cover all producers holding open recs, not just the loudest. Verified emitted key.
directives: No hardcoded producer lists - walk the registry

goals.title: At least one dispatch whenever work exists
goals.description: Liveness guard: zero dispatches across many ticks with non-empty accumulators means the dispatcher is stuck, not idle. Reuses recs_dispatched (verified emitted key).
directives: Distinguish 'queue empty' from 'all candidates skipped' in the run summary
